```plato

    // Apply only the linear part of a 2D affine map: the translation row is
    // skipped, as it must be for displacements and normals.
    TransformNormal(self: Vector2D, matrix: Matrix3x2): Vector2D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y);
```
